name: Ghetto Gangsters
description: Ghetto Gangsters are a section (faction) of the Almighty Imperial Gangsters Nation (AIGN), a predominantly Puerto Rican street gang based on the North Side of Chicago. The Ghetto Gangsters section was originated by a member known as Mijo and formed alongside other factions such as the Continental Gangsters within the broader Imperial Spanish Gangsters organization.
